added_findings.title: Back-ports B5 calls closed landed in TV only as files: VV is ahead on dimension config, StyleRows and per-drawing styles
added_findings.detail: (1) PlanDimensions split. TV 44/ has ConfigState__ and EditorPreview__, but TV's Data__ (988 lines) still defines every getter itself, and Editor__ (907) was not slimmed either. TV's FloorPlan and Elevation mode controllers load Data's copy (L161, L179). The only importer of the split ConfigState is LE MarkupBridge (L259, line and text setup). That copy's Na__PlanDim__Config is never loaded, so it serves fallbacks (static reading, not run). EditorPreview has no importer. VV is single-sourced: its mode controllers load from ConfigState (43 L194, 46 L199), and VV Data defines no getters. (2) TV 40/Na__DrawView__StyleRows__.js has no importer or caller. (3) Per-drawing style toggles (VV D33). TV has the record keys and reads them in MaterialPreset (L250-251) and RenderPreset, but Na__FpData__SetStyle, SetExcludeTokens and the Elevation equivalents have no caller, and TV's 2.0.0 row builders build no Styles or Exclusions rows. VV builds them through StyleRows (43 RowBuilders L92-93, L367-368; 46 RowBuilders L96-97, L563-564). c.1 recommends port_whole_reapply_vv for TV's 2.0.0 editors and row builders (rows 16, 17, 46, 47) with no StyleRows seam, and no_action for Data/Editor (rows 35, 38). Taking those TV files whole would delete VV's Styles/Exclusions UI and re-duplicate VV's dimension config.
added_findings.recommendation: Record these as VV-ahead divergences in the ledger, and keep ledger rows L1219, L1220 and L1225 open. Add the seam 'keep VV's Styles and Exclusions rows' to c.1 rows 16, 17, 46 and 47, and make rows 35 and 38 keep_vv_divergence. Finish the work in TV through WP-S11-09 once D-S11-06 and D-S11-10 are decided.

added_findings.title: The 'Source version' PORT NOTE line already exists in 72 VV files, and drift_all.tsv reads it as VV's version
added_findings.detail: 72 VV files carry '// - Source version: <TV module x.y.z> (<date>)': 20 in 50__System__ProjectedLinework, 13 in 45, 9 in 46, 8 in 43, 8 in 21, 6 in 44, 6 in 42 and 2 elsewhere. The forms vary, for example '1.0.0 (31-Aug-2026)' or 'Lantern Designer rebuild of 07-Aug-2026'. They were written at the Phase 0-5 port and never refreshed by the return-trip ports. No 51__System__LayoutEditor file has one, and TV has none. drift_all.tsv takes this value as vv_ver (VV 43/Na__FloorPlan__ModeController__.js is recorded 1.1.0, but its log tops at 1.2.2), so vv_ver for those rows is the TV origin version, not VV's own. D-S11-03 proposes a 'new' line that duplicates this convention.
added_findings.recommendation: Amend D-S11-03: extend the existing line rather than invent one (for example '- Source version: 1.1.0 (TrueVision3D v2.19.0, 07-Sep-2026)'), and refresh it on every port. WP-S11-03 parses both forms. The Module Register takes VV versions from each file's DEVELOPMENT LOG top, never from drift_all.tsv vv_ver.
added_findings.evidence: grep -rl -e '- Source version' over VV 02__Src__AppModules returns 72 files (0 in TV); VV 43__System__FloorPlanViews/Na__FloorPlan__ModeController__.js:49 vs log L63; ref/drift_all.tsv row Na__FloorPlan__ModeController__.js vv_ver 1.1.0.

The ObjectSnap PORT NOTE (L61) says it 'came across from 30__System__SheetTools/Na__LayoutEditor__Snapping__.js'. 11 VV modules import Snapping__: ModeController, SheetTools, SheetTools__ContextMenu, __HitResolution, __Keyboard, __PointerDrag, DimensionTool, LeaderTool, RectangleTool, ShapeTool and Toolbar. added_findings.recommendation: S04b does the move in one package together with the ObjectSnap port: delete Snapping__, rewrite all 11 importers in the same commit, run both harnesses, and have the scribe record the rename in the Module Register. Schedule it before the SheetTools hub ports (WP-S11-08).
added_findings.evidence: grep 'Na__LayoutEditor__Snapping__' across VV 02__Src__AppModules returns 12 files (11 importers plus the module itself); TV LE/28__System__ObjectSnap listing; TV Na__LayoutEditor__ObjectSnap__.js:61.

added_findings.title: Porting TV v2.82.0 DrawingPlanes retires VV's live FacePick, GizmoGrip and PlaneGizmo
added_findings.detail: TV's 45/Na__Elevation__FacePick__.js and __GizmoGrip__.js were back-ported from VV and are initialised from TV Index.html L910-912, but nothing uses them. TV v2.82.0 built 47__System__DrawingPlanes with its own grip and face pick (Na__PlaneGrip__StartFacePick, 'Aim at face'). Its PORT NOTE (Grip L59-61) reads: 'ValeVision: not yet ported. Supersedes Na__Elevation__GizmoGrip__ and Na__Elevation__FacePick__ there when it is.' TV v2.86.0 (devlog L7921) lists PlaneGizmo, GizmoGrip and FacePick as 'still on disk and initialised, unused since v2.82.0'. In VV these modules are live, and VV's editors hang behaviour on Pick Face: Pick Face queues a thumbnail bake (ledger L1103-1109), and Re-pick exists. The survey said DrawingPlanes and North import them; neither does.
added_findings.recommendation: S02a's DrawingPlanes package should do three things. (a) Move VV's Pick Face hooks (bake queueing, Re-pick) onto DrawingPlanes 'Aim at face'. (b) Either leave VV's FacePick/GizmoGrip/PlaneGizmo initialised but unused, as TV does, or retire them, decided once for both apps. (c) Correct ledger rows L29 and L1223 and TV plan row C.
added_findings.evidence: TV Index.html:910-912; TV 47__System__DrawingPlanes/Na__DrawingPlanes__Grip__.js:59-61,698; TV 46__System__NorthDirection/Na__North__PickTool__.js:49 ('after Na__Elevation__FacePick__', no import); TV devlog L7921; VV ledger L1103-1109.

notes:
The S11 survey was strong on the release backbone. Its counts, line references, watermark (TV v2.85.0 high / v2.28.0 low), ledger-hygiene findings, service-worker evidence and harness baseline all checked out, and every 'absent in VV' identifier I probed (about 110) is genuinely absent. Its weak points come from reading files' presence and dates instead of wiring.

VV is ahead there, and c.1's whole-file recommendations for the plan/elevation editors, row builders and PlanDimensions Data/Editor would delete VV behaviour (S11-V03).
2. The c.1 module table is not executable as written. Ten no_action rows hide TV changes VV lacks (cherry-picked ports, masking by VV's 28-Sep v2.71.0 edits, header-only rows with code; S11-V01). 44 of the 62 port_whole rows import TV modules VV does not have, three of them TV's Cloudflare client with no transport seam (S11-V02, Appendix D). 3. TV's FacePick/GizmoGrip are not imported by DrawingPlanes or North. DrawingPlanes superseded them in v2.82.0, and its port retires VV's live modules (S11-V09).
4. The survey did not read TV's 12 feature PLAN files. They record that the site plan VV question was asked on 14-Sep (v2.48.0/v2.49.0/v2.49.1 reclassified to PENDING-SIGNOFF), and they park 16 more releases.
